snippet.title: Hello Kitty Island Adventure – Deluxe Edition – Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
Hello Kitty Island Adventure – Deluxe Edition is now available physically on Nintendo Switch: https://ninten.do/6051q5D5W 
 
Your shelf is about to get super-cuter! Discover this cozy adventure with Hello Kitty and friends with a special illustrated fold-our map and splash art poster! 
 
#HelloKittyIslandAdventure #NintendoSwitch
